'''Darth Zavakon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent who served as one of the first members of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]]. As head of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]], Zavakon was responsible for the establishment of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]].

==Biography==
Darth Zavakon was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who lived in the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. In [[4999 BBY]], Zavakon departed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] with the rest of the surviving [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in order to escape the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the Sith defeat in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], and it was not until [[4980 BBY]] that the [[Sith exodus]] came to an end at [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. There, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] established a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Empire]], and Zavakon was chosen as one of the twelve [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] who formed the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]. Taking on the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge|recovery and study of ancient knowledge]] as his [[Spheres of Influence|area of influence]], Zavakon came to realize that the Empire was suffering because of his fellow Sith's unwillingness to share knowledge. As a result, he dispatched a team of [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologists]] and military [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to investigate ruins that other Sith had already surveyed. The significant discoveries made by Zavakon's team led the Dark Council to authorize the formation of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], a military organization devoted to preserving knowledge.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Zavakon was introduced in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', in the section on the Imperial Reclamation Service.
